issues.title: LaTeX rendering disconnected: LatexRenderer.tsx exists but is never invoked from MarkdownView
issues.description: MarkdownView.tsx handles block types: text, header, horizontal-rule, list, numbered-list, code-block, mermaid, options, table, image. The 'latex' block type is defined in parseMarkdown.ts (line 24) and LatexRenderer.tsx is fully implemented, but MarkdownView.tsx has no import of LatexRenderer and no 'latex' branch in its block renderer switch. LaTeX content parsed as 'latex' blocks falls through to 'return null' and is silently dropped. Browser-verified: '$$E = mc^2$$' appears as raw literal text in the DOM with no katex rendering.
issues.runtime_evidence: Browser evaluation: hasRenderedMath=false, hasLatexDelimiter=true. Raw text '$$E = mc^2$$' visible in DOM innerText.
issues.observation_notes: LatexRenderer.tsx exists at correct path and imports katex correctly. parseMarkdown.ts type definition includes 'latex' at line 24. The connection between parser output and renderer is missing.

issues.title: 'wrap' envelope type renders as 'Unknown event' -- no UI visualization for slash command prompts
issues.description: The 'wrap' session envelope type (skill/command prompt) is correctly produced by sessionProtocolMapper.ts and correctly normalized by typesRaw.ts:normalizeSessionEnvelope (line 577) into a NormalizedMessage with role:'event' and content:{type:'wrapped', label, content}. However, AgentEventBlock in MessageView.tsx handles only: 'switch', 'message', 'limit-reached'. It does NOT handle type:'wrapped'. The final else branch returns a generic 'Unknown event' text element. Slash command prompts sent via /slash-commands will appear as 'Unknown event' in the chat UI.

issues.title: Bug #63: Horizontal scroll indicator disabled for both code blocks and tables on web
issues.description: In MarkdownView.tsx, code blocks (RenderCodeBlock at line 187) have showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} unconditionally on all platforms. Tables (RenderTableBlock at line 308) have showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={Platform.OS !== 'web'} which evaluates to false on web. Both code blocks and tables lose their horizontal scroll indicator on the web app. Users cannot see that content overflows horizontally.
issues.runtime_evidence: Code review confirmed. Tables are visible and horizontally scrollable in browser but no scroll indicator shown.
issues.observation_notes: Code block scroll indicator is false on ALL platforms (not just web). Table scroll indicator is explicitly false on web. Both appear intentional but cause users to miss horizontally-overflowing content.

issues.title: Bug #62: change_title MCP sends 'summary' type message but server does not broadcast title update to browser
issues.description: The change_title MCP handler in startHappyServer.ts (line 67) calls client.sendClaudeSessionMessage({ type: 'summary', summary: title, leafUuid }). In apiSession.ts (line 414), the 'summary' type triggers updateMetadata() which sends an 'update-metadata' WebSocket message to the server. The server updates the session metadata in the database and broadcasts an update to connected clients. getSessionName() in sessionUtils.ts reads session.metadata?.summary?.text. The chain should work. However: sessionProtocolMapper.ts (lines 481-486) explicitly ignores 'summary' type messages and returns empty envelopes. The session list title shown as 'root' (the working directory) suggests metadata.summary is not populated or not decrypted correctly for these sessions. The title update path may work for new sessions but fail to update sidebar display for the currently viewed session.
issues.runtime_evidence: Sessions shown with name 'root' (working directory path) rather than any named title, confirming title from metadata.summary is not surfaced. Cannot verify live update without triggering change_title MCP call.
issues.observation_notes: The sidebar title comes from session.metadata.summary.text when present, else falls back to path last segment. Two test sessions both show 'root' suggesting metadata.summary is absent or empty. The full update chain involves E2E encryption of metadata -- decryption failure would silently show fallback.

issues.title: Bug #64: ToolView.tsx missing visual divider between header and content area for all tool types
issues.description: ToolView.tsx styles.content (line 328) defines only paddingHorizontal: 12, paddingTop: 8 -- no borderTopWidth, borderTopColor, or separator element. The header has backgroundColor: theme.colors.surfaceHighest while content renders on the container backgroundColor: theme.colors.surfaceHigh, but there is no explicit divider line separating header from content. This affects all tool views including TaskView, BashView, EditView.
issues.runtime_evidence: Browser snapshot shows tool blocks render with collapsible header and content, visual separation relies on background color contrast only.
issues.observation_notes: The background color difference (surfaceHighest for header, surfaceHigh for container) provides implicit visual separation, but Bug #64 documents this as a regression vs prior behavior that had an explicit border.

issues.title: Main JS bundle 7.4MB uncompressed served without gzip -- ~10x above 300KB threshold
issues.description: The nginx container serving happy-web-dev delivers the main JS bundle (index-2ebd668410d0f6a3cf7d93259078783e.js) at 7,747,175 bytes with no Content-Encoding header (no gzip/brotli compression). The common chunk is an additional 2,425,868 bytes. Total initial JS payload: ~10.2MB uncompressed. With gzip, typical compression ratio for JS is 3-4x, which would yield ~2.5-3.4MB -- still above ideal but far more reasonable. The missing compression also affects the katex bundle (268KB) and multiple mermaid diagram chunks. Page load time measured at ~50ms (cached), but first-visit cold load would be severely impacted.
issues.location: Docker container: happy-web-dev nginx configuration; Dockerfile.webapp (nginx config not checked for gzip_static)
issues.runtime_evidence: curl -sI showed Content-Length: 7747175 with no Content-Encoding header. Browser network tab showed all static JS served at full uncompressed size.
issues.observation_notes: The bundle size is partly driven by bundled mermaid diagram chunks (architectureDiagram 148KB, sequenceDiagram 115KB, sankeyDiagram 96KB, etc.) which are lazy-loaded on demand. The core issue is missing nginx gzip_static configuration.

issues.title: Redundant parallel API calls on page load -- 4x /v1/feed, 2x /v1/machines, /v1/sessions, /v1/friends, /v1/artifacts
issues.description: Network analysis shows on settings page load: GET /v1/feed?limit=100 called 4 times, GET /v1/machines called 2 times, GET /v1/sessions called 2 times, GET /v1/friends called 2 times, GET /v1/artifacts called 2 times. These redundant calls occur within the same page load event. This suggests multiple React components or sync hooks independently trigger the same API calls without deduplication. All return 200 but represent wasted bandwidth and unnecessary server load.
issues.runtime_evidence: Browser network requests: /v1/feed?limit=100 appears 4 times in single page load sequence; /v1/machines, /v1/sessions, /v1/friends, /v1/artifacts each appear 2x.
issues.observation_notes: No 4xx/5xx errors from these duplicate calls. The API server handles them correctly. The root cause is likely multiple sync subscribers or WebSocket reconnect events triggering full data refresh.
